verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single Mac Help topic title, "Run Windows on your Mac" [macos-docs-18]. It implies macOS can coexist with another OS on the same machine, but it doesn't say whether that means a true dual-boot (separate partition with a boot picker) or virtualization. Missing for 10: explicit dual-boot or Boot Camp documentation, partitioning and boot-selection steps, supported hardware and OS combinations, and independent hands-on confirmation.
